name: Extract document text
summary: Read real text and rows out of CSV, XLSX, DOCX and text-based PDFs, or pasted document text.
author: friday-core
description: Read-only document extract. File bytes and URLs run as the built-in docs.extract skill (electron/document-extract.cjs). This sandbox pack extracts pasted text or CSV so capability-verify can run offline. Scanned PDFs fail honestly until OCR is wired on the same extract path.
